sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Keeps the medical interface clear of system bars.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Removes promotional banners and in-app messages.
Unlocks premium practice features. Paid NCERT questions and videos are not unlocked. Requires a signed-in account.
